:::{#exr-check-hessian}
#### Checking the second derivative

Confirm that the Hessian $\ell''(\lambda; \vx)$ is negative
when evaluated at $\tilde \lambda$, using @exr-hessian.

:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#sol-check-hessian}

$$
\begin{aligned}
\ell''(\tilde\lambda; \vx)
&= -\frac{n \bar x}{\tilde\lambda^2}
&& \text{(Hessian of the log-likelihood)}\\
&= -\frac{n \bar x}{\bar x^2}
&& \text{(substitute $\tilde\lambda = \bar x$)}\\
&= -\frac{n}{\bar x}
&& \text{(cancel one factor of $\bar x$)}\\
&< 0
&& \text{($n > 0$ and $\bar x > 0$)}
\end{aligned}
$$

:::
